steps.message: Quantos chamados foram abertos em agosto de 2026 pelo analista André Brito?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito'));
SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito')) ORDER BY ticket;

steps.message: e quantos do analista Fernando Alves?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Fernando Alves'));
